customDescriptions.value: Spawn a generic 3D actor in the simulation scene — use for placing static or dynamic objects in the virtual environment
Read the position and orientation of a 3D actor — use for getting ground-truth pose of objects in the scene
Set the position and orientation of a 3D actor — use for programmatically moving objects in the virtual scene
Spawn an animated 3D bicyclist in the scene — use for simulating vulnerable road users in traffic scenarios
Attach a virtual camera to capture images in the 3D scene — use for generating synthetic camera data for perception testing
Read the viewport camera position and settings — use for querying the observer camera state in the 3D scene
Attach a virtual fisheye camera in the 3D scene — use for wide-angle synthetic imagery for surround-view perception testing
Read joystick input for interactive 3D simulation — use for manual control of vehicles or cameras in the 3D scene
Attach a virtual lidar sensor in the 3D scene — use for generating synthetic point cloud data for perception algorithm development
Receive messages from the 3D simulation engine — use for reading events or custom data from the Unreal Engine scene
Send messages to the 3D simulation engine — use for triggering events or passing custom data to the Unreal Engine scene
Spawn an animated 3D pedestrian in the scene — use for simulating walking people in traffic or safety scenarios
Generate synthetic radar detections from the 3D scene — use for testing radar processing without physical hardware
Cast rays into the 3D scene and return hit information — use for custom proximity sensing or line-of-sight checks
Configure the 3D simulation environment — use for selecting scene, weather, lighting, and rendering options for the virtual world
Read 3D SpaceMouse input for scene navigation — use for 6-DOF camera or object manipulation in the 3D environment
Simulate an array of ultrasonic sensors in the 3D scene — use for testing parking assist or close-range detection algorithms
Simulate a single ultrasonic sensor in the 3D scene — use for testing proximity detection at close range
Spawn a 3D vehicle that follows terrain elevation — use for realistic vehicle visualization on roads with grade changes
Record video from the 3D simulation scene — use for capturing rendered footage for review or documentation
